review_kind: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5), no native-speaker signoff
note: Instruction 316, maintainer decision 2026-09-25: runtime (GUI) translation debt written and technically reviewed by AI against the English source and its code context. No human and no native speaker has read these rows.

records.key: Cellpose 4 fine-tuning uses AdamW. Start with 100 epochs, learning rate 0.00001, weight decay 0.1 and minibatch size 1.
records.source: Cellpose 4 fine-tuning uses AdamW. Start with 100 epochs, learning rate 0.00001, weight decay 0.1 and minibatch size 1.
records.translation: Finjustering i Cellpose 4 använder AdamW. Börja med 100 epoker, inlärningshastighet 0.00001, viktavklingning 0.1 och minibatchstorlek 1.

records.key: Choose an individual-parasite table with explicit parent-vacuole links, or a measured count column on each vacuole. Do not supply both. Without count inputs, replication remains unmeasured rather than being inferred from recruitment or host identity.
records.source: Choose an individual-parasite table with explicit parent-vacuole links, or a measured count column on each vacuole. Do not supply both. Without count inputs, replication remains unmeasured rather than being inferred from recruitment or host identity.
records.translation: Välj en tabell över enskilda parasiter med uttryckliga länkar till föräldravakuolen, eller en uppmätt kolumn med antal för varje vakuol. Ange inte båda. Utan indata om antal förblir replikationen omätt i stället för att härledas från rekrytering eller värdcellens identitet.

records.key: Choose direct parasite counts or the legacy host-aggregated area proxy. The whole-vacuole deep-learning classifier is coming soon and cannot run until a trained model is available.
records.source: Choose direct parasite counts or the legacy host-aggregated area proxy. The whole-vacuole deep-learning classifier is coming soon and cannot run until a trained model is available.
records.translation: Välj direkt räkning av parasiter eller den äldre areaproxyn som summeras per värdcell. Klassificeraren för hela vakuoler baserad på djupinlärning kommer snart och kan inte köras förrän en tränad modell finns.

records.key: Choose where trained weights are saved and whether intermediate epoch checkpoints are retained.
records.source: Choose where trained weights are saved and whether intermediate epoch checkpoints are retained.
records.translation: Välj var tränade vikter sparas och om mellanliggande epokkontrollpunkter behålls.

records.key: Compare each vacuole's marker intensity with its host reference compartment and classify joint marker states using explicit ratio thresholds. Calibrate thresholds with assay controls; missing or invalid references remain unknown.
records.source: Compare each vacuole's marker intensity with its host reference compartment and classify joint marker states using explicit ratio thresholds. Calibrate thresholds with assay controls; missing or invalid references remain unknown.
records.translation: Jämför varje vakuols markörintensitet med referenskompartmentet i dess värdcell och klassificera kombinerade markörtillstånd med uttryckliga kvottrösklar. Kalibrera trösklarna med analysens kontroller; saknade eller ogiltiga referenser förblir okända.

records.key: Configure area bins and scale for the legacy replication estimate. It combines pathogen area within a host and is neither a direct parasite count nor a measured three-dimensional volume.
records.source: Configure area bins and scale for the legacy replication estimate. It combines pathogen area within a host and is neither a direct parasite count nor a measured three-dimensional volume.
records.translation: Konfigurera areaintervall och skala för den äldre replikationsuppskattningen. Den summerar patogenarea inom en värdcell och är varken en direkt räkning av parasiter eller en uppmätt tredimensionell volym.

records.key: Control sparse-field filtering, dataset size and Cellpose's online random scale augmentation without creating duplicate images.
records.source: Control sparse-field filtering, dataset size and Cellpose's online random scale augmentation without creating duplicate images.
records.translation: Styr filtrering av glesa fält, datamängdens storlek och den slumpmässiga skalaugmenteringen i Cellpose under träningen utan att skapa dubblettbilder.

records.key: Fine-tune stock Cellpose-SAM or an existing checkpoint; name the new trained model separately.
records.source: Fine-tune stock Cellpose-SAM or an existing checkpoint; name the new trained model separately.
records.translation: Finjustera standardmodellen Cellpose-SAM eller en befintlig kontrollpunkt; ge den nya tränade modellen ett eget namn.

records.key: Optional rotations and reflections during phenotype prediction. Combine predictions by averaging or voting, retain the original prediction, and flag disagreement for review. All augmentation switches are off by default; agreement measures orientation stability, not calibrated confidence or biological accuracy.
records.source: Optional rotations and reflections during phenotype prediction. Combine predictions by averaging or voting, retain the original prediction, and flag disagreement for review. All augmentation switches are off by default; agreement measures orientation stability, not calibrated confidence or biological accuracy.
records.translation: Valfria rotationer och speglingar under fenotypprediktion. Kombinera prediktioner genom medelvärdesbildning eller röstning, behåll den ursprungliga prediktionen och flagga oenighet för granskning. Alla augmenteringsreglage är avstängda som standard; samstämmighet mäter orienteringsstabilitet, inte kalibrerad konfidens eller biologisk korrekthet.

records.key: Pair microscopy images with integer object-label masks, and optionally supply a separate validation set.
records.source: Pair microscopy images with integer object-label masks, and optionally supply a separate validation set.
records.translation: Para ihop mikroskopibilder med heltalsmasker med objektetiketter och ange eventuellt en separat valideringsuppsättning.

records.key: Screen raw fields before segmentation using channel-specific focus, saturation and nonfinite-pixel criteria. Choose report-only review or explicit saved exclusions; calibrate thresholds for the acquisition. Screening is off by default and never excludes images for low object counts.
records.source: Screen raw fields before segmentation using channel-specific focus, saturation and nonfinite-pixel criteria. Choose report-only review or explicit saved exclusions; calibrate thresholds for the acquisition. Screening is off by default and never excludes images for low object counts.
records.translation: Granska råa fält före segmentering med kanalspecifika kriterier för fokus, mättnad och icke-ändliga pixlar. Välj enbart rapport för granskning eller uttryckliga sparade uteslutningar; kalibrera trösklarna för insamlingen. Granskningen är avstängd som standard och utesluter aldrig bilder på grund av få objekt.
